answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 4877 Country: India Title: Is it appropriate for Imaam to repeat same first khutba in every Juma namaaz? Question: Is it appropriate for Imaam to repeat same first khutba in every Juma namaaz? Answer ID: 4877 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 487/487=M-1429) The khutbah is very much similar to ibadat and zikr . Therefore, it is no wrong to deliver same khutbah on every Jumah. Yes, if one is capable of delivering new khutbah on every Jumah on different subjects as per the circumstances, then it is a good thing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
